paper_title: Token-Level Uncertainty Estimation for Large Language Model Reasoning
caption: Left: Uncertainty estimation with different perturbation strength _q. Right: Influence of perturbation strength on uncertainty-based AUROC scores.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates how different variables, labeled as AU, TU, and EU, change with varying perturbation strength, denoted as σₐ. The x-axis is labeled "Perturbation Strength σₐ", uses a custom scale, and ranges from 0.02 to 0.5, with tick labels at intervals of 0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2 and 0.5. The y-axis represents an unnamed variable, also on a linear scale, ranging from 0.000 to 0.200, with tick labels at intervals of 0.025. The red line, representing AU, starts at 0.125 at x = 0.02, remain stable till 0.2 and gradually increases to approximately 0.162 at x = 0.5. The blue line, representing TU, starts at 0.125 at x = 0.02, remains nearly constant till 0.1, then rises sharply to about 0.192 at x = 0.5. The green line, representing EU, starts at 0.000 at x = 0.02, remain stable till x = 0.05 and gradually increases, reaching around 0.050 at x = 0.5. All lines marked with circles and also uses a solid line. A legend is given top left.
